registry_reuse.reason: Existing Go mission parser/rotation/index infrastructure is reused. No package-like AILANG capability or .ail module; registry package search and package inspection are inapplicable. No new package, script or dependency.

features.description: Parse stapledon's numbered and unnumbered date-first legacy headings, stably keep notes with preceding numbered neighbours, preserve live bytes on no-archive runs, collapse generated archive notices on real rotations, and refuse unparsed record-like preamble headings before any writes.
acceptance_criteria: D1: numbered date-first headings with optional parenthesised qualifier parse anywhere as Num/Date/Title; Title retains (qualifier) and drops iteration N prefix. Unnumbered dated headings parse anywhere as Num=-1 notes. pre-iteration 0 is a note. Both patterns are recognised by strayHeadings and ignoredIndexHeadings and documented in entryHeadingRe's deliberately tolerant fleet-format comment.

D2: assign sort keys in original file order: numbered Num, note nearest preceding numbered Num or -1. Stable sort decorated entries by those keys; numbered ordering unchanged and October 2 attended note stays between iterations 8 and 9. Do not change index row format or ordering.

D3: Archived==0 performs no live-log write or archive write, live SHA256 remains unchanged for keep equal to and greater than count, LogAfter==LogBefore, index still written. cmd/ailang/mission_rotate.go adds only one conditional output line: live log was not modified (no entries archived).

D4: only on real rotation, strip all generated four-line blockquotes from preamble anchored by > **Older entries are ARCHIVED.** and following > continuation lines, preserving surrounding prose verbatim; write exactly one fresh notice. Tests require 3 copies -> 1 and 1 -> 1 across two real rotations with an appended numbered entry between runs.

D5: before any log/archive/index write and before generic zero-entry refusal, reject first unparsed preamble ## heading starting with a digit-led YYYY-MM-DD date or decimal number, or containing word iteration followed by decimal number (case-insensitive). Error names first offending heading; pre-seeded log/archive/index remain byte-identical. Cover all predicate branches and zero parsed entries. Allow every M5 template/structural heading; RegenerateIndex/--index-only does not apply the new guard.

D6: check in internal/mission/testdata/stapledon-log-headings.txt generated by M3 git show/grep command from origin/main 50d8d5ba (use pinned commit if ref moved), never hand-type. Require successful pipeline and fixture exactly 41 non-empty heading lines before tests use it; missing/truncated fixture is INSTRUMENT FAILURE. Strip trailing carriage return per fixture line for Windows without changing .gitattributes.

Fixture-built log (each heading plus one body line) parses as 41 entries: 38 numbered and 3 notes, no preamble record headings, zero stray/ignored headings. keep=20 archives 21 and keeps 20; exact archive sequence is oldest 21 in file order, October 2 note between iterations 8 and 9. From empty prior index assert all 38 numbered rows 0-9, 11, 12, 14, 16-24, 26-41 plus note preservation; verify qualifier titles and pre-iteration note Num=-1.

Record baseline green and each intended arm red under disposable mutations: delete numbered date-first recognition; disable unnumbered date-first recognition; let numbered regex accept pre-iteration 0; restore sort.Slice by Num; write live log unconditionally; skip notice stripping; delete preamble guard. Fixture instrument control rejects missing/truncated input. Record rc and intended assertion, not merely compile failure; use cp/mktemp or saved-copy restore, never git checkout.

Existing tests remain green unchanged; no inspected test pins duplicate notices. Add rotate_legacy_test.go companion rather than expanding rotate_test.go. go test ./internal/mission/ returns rc 0; go test ./cmd/ailang/ -run 'Rotate|MissionRotate' returns rc 0; gofmt -l internal/mission cmd/ailang returns rc 0 and empty output; make check-changelog returns rc 0.

D7: changelogs/unreleased/2026-10-20-rotate-log-legacy-headings.md has 2-5 lines and its exact first line is: ### Fixed — mission rotate-log reads date-first legacy headings, never no-ops silently, and writes one archive notice

D8: implementation limited to internal/mission/rotate.go, new internal/mission/rotate_legacy_test.go, internal/mission/index.go recognition in ignoredIndexHeadings only, generated fixture, cmd/ailang/mission_rotate.go D3 output line only, and named changelog fragment. Exclude normalize.go/mission normalize, index row format, .gitattributes, real mission logs and unrelated paths; two plan artifacts are the only planner writes.

Controller alone, outside sandbox, runs make test-launchd-drivers and HEAD-vs-new binary rotate-log --keep 20 corpus check on separate SCRATCH copies of v1, fleet, docs, triage, motoko, world (~/dev/sunholo-data/ailang-world), stapledon and associated archives/indexes via scratch registries. Compare entry counts, archived counts and resulting files; only stapledon now rotating and collapsed duplicate notices may differ. Do not prescribe make test or go build ./.... Label every socket-touching result UNINFORMATIVE UNDER SANDBOX.
